item.title: Temporal Disturbance and Applied Paradoxology: A Case Study of Frank the Rabbit
item.description: A darkly satirical exploration of nonlinear causality, prophetic insomnia, and jet-engine meteorology as illustrated in Richard Kelly’s *Donnie Darko* (2001).
